newsitem.title: USA: UPR SAYS RECEIVES PROPOSALS FOR PENNZOIL.
newsitem.headline: UPR SAYS RECEIVES PROPOSALS FOR PENNZOIL.

text.p: Union Pacific Resources Group Inc said in a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission that is receiving interest from third parties regarding certain assets of its own and Pennzoil Co, for which it has made a hostile takeover bid.

"...UPR plans to discuss with various entities the feasibility and desirability of entering into, and possible terms of, agreements for such transactions before or after the consummation of the offer," it said in a filing dated Friday.
UPR has made an $84 cash offer for 50.1 percent of Pennzoil and is offering its own stock for the remainder.
